title: Budget Billing Monthly Deferral and Recovery on Regular Bills
content:
# Budget Billing Monthly Deferral and Recovery on Regular Bills

**Rule.** On every regular bill of an active Budget Billing plan, the bill's actual charges are compared with the installment: the excess is booked as a deferral and credited off the collectible balance, and a shortfall is booked as a recovery and billed, so that the amount due on the bill equals the installment. Equal amounts book nothing. Each bill is compared once, and only for a plan in active status.

## The comparison, case by case

| Actual charges of the regular bill compared with the installment | Entry booked | Amount of the entry | Effect on the bill | Effect on the deferred balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Higher | Deferral | Actual charges less the installment | Credited off the collectible balance | Increases by the deferral |
| Lower | Recovery | Installment less actual charges | Billed on the bill | Decreases by the recovery |
| Equal | None | — | None | Unchanged |

In each case the amount due on the bill equals the installment.

## Which bills are compared

- **Plan status.** Only a plan in active status has its bills compared. A plan that is enrolled but whose first plan bill has not yet been issued, and a plan that is withdrawn, removed or closed, books neither a deferral nor a recovery.
- **Once per bill.** Each regular bill is compared once. A bill that already carries a deferral or a recovery for the plan is not compared again.
- **Authority.** The plan's status is read from the company's plan record for that plan as it stands when the bill is compared.

## Hypothetical bills on an active plan with an installment of $140

| Bill | Actual charges | Entry | Amount | Amount due | Deferred balance after the bill (starting from $0.00) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| January | $186.25 | Deferral | $46.25 | $140.00 | $46.25 owed |
| February | $171.10 | Deferral | $31.10 | $140.00 | $77.35 owed |
| March | $140.00 | None | — | $140.00 | $77.35 owed |
| April | $98.60 | Recovery | $41.40 | $140.00 | $35.95 owed |
| May | $82.00 | Recovery | $58.00 | $140.00 | $22.05 in the customer's favour |

The entries are dated on the bill date of the bill compared.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a bill with charges equal to the installment create an entry?** No. Equal amounts book nothing; the amount due is the installment and the deferred balance is unchanged.

**Can a recovery take the deferred balance into the customer's favour?** Yes. A recovery is the installment less the actual charges of the bill, whatever the balance stands at; in the May row above the recovery of $58.00 exceeds the $35.95 owed, and the balance moves to $22.05 in the customer's favour.
